answer_2.quote: We evaluate our models in terms of overall translation quality (BLEU) and also employ three types of automatic pronoun‑focused evaluation: Accuracy of Pronoun Translation (APT), Precision/Recall/F1 (AutoPRF), and an ELMo‑based CRC metric.
